Container.Name: Plex LDAP Gateway
Container.Overview: Plex LDAP Gateway exposes a small ASGI control plane and a real LDAP listener that authenticates users against Plex and scopes authorization with a Plex owner token plus machine identifier.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent application data.

Config.Name: LDAP Port
Config.Description: LDAP listener port exposed by the container.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: HTTP health and readiness port exposed by the container.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID used by the LinuxServer base image.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID used by the LinuxServer base image.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container time zone.

Config.Name: PLEX_OWNER_TOKEN
Config.Description: Plex owner token used to enumerate and authorize directory users.

Config.Name: PLEX_MACHINE_IDENTIFIER
Config.Description: Plex Media Server machineIdentifier used to scope directory access.

Config.Name: PLEX_BASE_URL
Config.Description: Base Plex API URL.

Config.Name: PLEX_CLIENT_PRODUCT
Config.Description: Client product string sent to Plex.

Config.Name: PLEX_CLIENT_VERSION
Config.Description: Client version string sent to Plex.

Config.Name: PLEX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
Config.Description: Timeout for Plex API requests.

Config.Name: GATEWAY_LDAP_STRICT_MACHINE_MATCH
Config.Description: Restrict LDAP users to Plex accounts with access to the configured machine identifier.

Config.Name: GATEWAY_LDAP_REFRESH_SECONDS
Config.Description: How long directory snapshots stay cached before a refresh.

Config.Name: GATEWAY_LDAP_BASE_DN
Config.Description: Base DN for the generated LDAP directory.

Config.Name: GATEWAY_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Application log threshold. Supported values: critical, error, warning, info, debug.

Config.Name: GATEWAY_LOG_OUTPUT
Config.Description: Where application logs are written. Supported values: console, file, both.

Config.Name: GATEWAY_LOG_FILE_PATH
Config.Description: File path used when log output includes file mode.

Config.Name: SERVICE_CRASH_MAX_ATTEMPTS
Config.Description: Maximum supervised process crashes before the container exits.

Config.Name: SERVICE_CRASH_WINDOW_SECONDS
Config.Description: Crash accounting window for the supervised process.

Config.Name: SERVICE_CRASH_BACKOFF_SECONDS
Config.Description: Delay between supervised process restart attempts.
